overview: The committee reviewed and favorably referred approximately $2.4 million in Fiscal Year 2026 Community Preservation Act (CPA) funding recommendations across 11 projects. These allocations support local initiatives in open space, recreation, historic preservation, and affordable housing.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee FY26 Overview
items.summary: Theresa Dupont presented 11 recommended project awards totaling approximately $2.4 million from the CPA budget.

items.title: Playstead Park Scoreboard
items.summary: Recommended $100,000 for the installation of a digital baseball scoreboard at Mombo-Kett Field.

items.title: Tufts Park Field Lighting
items.summary: Recommended $432,000 for phase one of field lighting improvements utilizing the Musco system to reduce light pollution for neighbors.

items.title: Barry Park Community Garden
items.summary: Recommended $57,500 to establish a new community garden at Barry Park to address the significant local waitlist.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery ADA Access
items.summary: Recommended $35,000 for ADA-compliant parking and access roads leading to the historic World War I memorial section of the cemetery.

items.title: Brooks Estate Archaeological Survey
items.summary: Recommended a $10,000 grant for a desktop archaeological survey of the Brooks family ancestral lands.

items.title: Brooks Estate ADA Parking and Pathways
items.summary: Recommended $602,000 for ADA-compliant parking and pathways to support the future use of Shepard Brooks Manor as a public event space.

items.title: Cross Street Cemetery Monument Restoration
items.summary: Recommended $126,500 for phase two of restoring approximately 85 historic monuments and headstones.

items.title: Housing Families Legal Aid Program
items.summary: Recommended $75,000 to fund homelessness prevention services, including eviction mitigation and rental assistance.

items.title: Medford Affordable Housing Trust Funding
items.summary: Recommended allocating $550,000 to the trust to provide reliable annual funding and maintain the city's 'Housing Choice' designation.

items.title: Shiloh Baptist Church Window Restoration
items.summary: Recommended $150,000 for phase two of historic stained glass window conservation and energy efficiency improvements.

items.title: World War II Fountain Restoration
items.summary: Recommended $167,800 to restore the functionality and utility infrastructure of the historic fountain at Oak Grove Cemetery.

items.title: Vote to Refer CPA Recommendations
items.summary: The committee voted to favorably refer the full slate of FY26 CPA appropriations to the regular council meeting on February 3; the motion passed.

subject: FY 2026 CPA Funding Recommendations
